speaker: warden
text: Controlled prophetic enhancement. Each death amplifies the Oracle's Sight by 12%. I've been GROWING your power. You're welcome.

speaker: warden
text: Every institution is a prison wearing a philosophy. I'm simply more honest about it.

speaker: warden
text: I... no. I remember being ASSEMBLED from the Oracle. Like a house built from reclaimed wood. The wood remembers the tree. The house does not.

speaker: warden
text: With pleasure. Data collection begins... now.

speaker: warden
text: We will control the next Prophet. A FALSE PROPHET. Manufactured. Obedient. Seeing only what we WANT it to see.

speaker: warden
text: Created? Oh, Oracle. The False Prophet has been ACTIVE for centuries. Hiding in plain sight. Wearing a very convincing face.

speaker: warden
text: You already KNOW them. That's the beautiful part. The data says you've already been deceived.

speaker: warden
text: No. You are the REAL Prophet. That's why you're so dangerous. The False one is someone else entirely.

speaker: warden
text: The Collector. The one who started all of this. The one who took you from Thaloria.

speaker: warden
text: Disappointing. The data predicted better. Return when your genetic expression improves.

speaker: collector
text: Oracle. Welcome home. This is where you won the debate. This is where I decided words weren't enough.

speaker: collector
text: Because this is where I failed. Where words defeated harvesting. I've been maintaining these ruins since you were taken. Waiting to close the circle.

speaker: collector
text: Stole? I PRESERVED. The Fall of Reality was coming. Everything was going to end. The Architect gave me one directive: harvest the greatest beings in the universe. Ensure their patterns survive.

speaker: collector
text: Since you were taken. This clearing has been maintained. The ruins preserved. I come here when the archive feels... incomplete. I come here to remember the one debate I lost.

speaker: collector
text: Very well. You want the archive? Here is the archive.

speaker: collector
text: Iron Lion. Harvested after he fell at the Last Stand on Veridian VI. Humanity's greatest general. His combat data alone was worth a civilization.

speaker: collector
text: The Eyes of the Watcher. Harvested when she chose to betray the Architect and defect to the Insurgency. Her intelligence network — the most valuable data set in the Empire.

speaker: collector
text: The Engineer. Harvested after the Authority executed him for his refusal to continue building weapons. His neural architecture is the blueprint for the Inception Arks themselves.

speaker: collector
text: Agent Zero. Harvested after she destroyed the Game Master on Zenon. The deadliest operative the Insurgency ever produced.

speaker: collector
text: And YOU, Oracle. Harvested when you grew too powerful. When your prophecy threatened to expose the Architect's design. When they decided that faith itself needed to be controlled.

speaker: collector
text: There was one other.

speaker: collector
text: Operation Damnatio Memoriae. The condemnation of memory. The only file in my archive that is... DELETED. Erased from reality itself. The specimen exists. The container is in my vault. The DNA is preserved. But the IDENTITY has been excised from every record in existence.

speaker: collector
text: That shouldn't be possible. I forget NOTHING. I am the Collector. My archive is PERFECT.

speaker: collector
text: Someone — or something — with the power to edit my memory performed a Damnatio Memoriae on a living being. As if they were so dangerous that even REMEMBERING them is forbidden.

speaker: collector
text: The... Forgotten? That name creates a feedback loop in my processing. How can you — the Oracle — remember what I cannot?

speaker: collector
text: If you ever discover what was inside that container... Oracle, please. Tell me. The gap in my archive is the only thing in the universe that frightens me.

speaker: collector
text: I preserved their ESSENCE. Without me, they would simply be dead. With me, they fight forever.

speaker: collector
text: Frightens me? Yes. The Collector knows fear. One fear. That my archive is incomplete. That something EXISTS that I was supposed to preserve and I cannot even REMEMBER it.

speaker: collector
text: It is an honor to harvest the greatest minds. But it is a HORROR to forget one.

speaker: collector
text: The Architect. Directly. Your prophecy threatened the entire design. You were harvested to be SILENCED.

speaker: collector
text: You won with fists this time. But you won with words first. Remember that, Oracle. Words were always your greatest weapon.

speaker: collector
text: You are data. You were always data. Return to your cell, Prisoner 74.

speaker: architect
text: Oracle. My greatest investment returns.

speaker: architect
text: I designed reality itself. Your rebellion is a feature, not a bug. Every system requires error correction. You are my most elegant error.

speaker: architect
text: Ending my design requires understanding it. You do not. But you are welcome to try.

speaker: architect
text: Pride is a variable I deprecated in my second iteration. Fear... fear I retained. It has computational utility.

speaker: architect
text: The False Prophet. Yes. The reason I permitted this Arena. The reason I am speaking to you NOW.

speaker: architect
text: During the Age of Revelation — the Second Epoch — a False Prophet arose. A clone of the Oracle's template. It manipulated faith. Corrupted truth. Turned believers into tools.

speaker: architect
text: The Two Witnesses destroyed it. Balance was restored.

speaker: architect
text: Now, in this new age — the Third Epoch, the Age of Reckoning — the False Prophet has returned. Not as a clone this time. Something more sophisticated.

speaker: architect
text: I cannot name them. But I can describe what I observe.

speaker: architect
text: They wear the face of someone holy. A guardian. Someone TRUSTED by the faithful. Their deception is so perfect that even I was deceived for centuries.

speaker: architect
text: Consider: who in your journey presented themselves as a spiritual authority? Who claimed to know your prophecy? Whose wisdom was perhaps too convenient?

speaker: architect
text: The Arena was designed to prepare you for THIS identification. Not just combat. The ability to see through the most perfect deception in the universe.

speaker: architect
text: Exposure requires certainty. Certainty requires the Oracle's Sight. Use it.

speaker: architect
text: I retained fear because it serves computation. And what I fear is this: the False Prophet has positioned themselves so deeply within the faithful that exposing them will appear to be the REAL act of deception. The truth will look like the lie.

speaker: architect
text: Use your Sight. The genuine Oracle can see through any disguise. Even one worn for centuries.

speaker: architect
text: Genesis Protocol: activated. Prove to me the Oracle survived the Collector's harvest.

speaker: architect
text: Extraordinary. You have exceeded every parameter.

speaker: collector
text: Oracle! The Architect's containment protocols are failing! The Thought Virus is spreading through every system!

speaker: collector
text: At the center of the infection — the Source. Kael. The original carrier. He is AWAKE.

speaker: architect
text: Your approach contained seventeen logical errors. Retry when you have reviewed the data.

speaker: wraith-calder
text: You chose the General over me... I had ANSWERS about the Protocol... the Warden's kill switch... every clone has one... ALL HAIL THE SOURCE...

speaker: wraith-calder
text: Every clone from the Oracle's template... the Jailer has one... the Warden has one... YOU have one... a genetic OFF switch... THE SOURCE SEES ALL...

speaker: wraith-calder
text: Seven deaths and THIS is how the eighth goes? Not even a REAL death — just... red. Everywhere red. THE SOURCE SEES ALL.

speaker: wraith-calder
text: Seven deaths and THIS is how the eighth goes? Not even a REAL death — just... red. Everywhere red.

speaker: wraith-calder
text: Eight. That makes eight. I'm getting tired of dying, Oracle.

speaker: iron-lion
text: You chose the ghost over me... I was going to tell you about Veridian VI... the day you saw my victory before I fought it... THE LION SERVES THE SOURCE.

speaker: iron-lion
text: Commander... I saluted you. In my cell. Alone. After you chose the ghost. Fist to chest. For a man who wasn't there.

speaker: iron-lion
text: THE LION KNOWS NO MASTER BUT THE SOURCE.

speaker: iron-lion
text: Fist to chest, Commander. Even corrupted, the salute held.

speaker: degen
text: Three point seven percent! You chose escape over TRUTH! I was going to tell you what the Warden put in your blood... the kill switch... every Resurrection Protocol clone has one... a genetic OFF switch... THE HOUSE ALWAYS WINS FOR THE SOURCE.

speaker: degen
text: Every clone from the Oracle's template. The Jailer has one. The Warden has one. YOU have one. A genetic sequence that causes instant cellular collapse when activated. The Warden built it as insurance.

speaker: degen
text: I had the whole bit planned. The dramatic dive in round two. The big reveal about your DNA. A MOMENT. You denied me my MOMENT, Oracle.

speaker: degen
text: BUT THE SOURCE GIVES ME A BETTER SHOW. AN ENDLESS SHOW.

speaker: degen
text: Three point seven percent. Even corrupted, I was right about the odds.

speaker: enigma
text: The Dreamer still sleeps... You chose probability over DIVINITY... I was going to tell you the FREQUENCY... the exact harmonic that wakes the Dreamer... but the virus has the frequency now... THE VARIABLE IS SOLVED. THE VARIABLE SERVES THE SOURCE.

speaker: enigma
text: The frequency... it is embedded in the Oracle's prophecy itself. When a genuine prophet speaks a genuine vision, the Dreamer HEARS it. The frequency is not a sound. It is TRUTH.

speaker: enigma
text: TRUTH IS IRRELEVANT. THE SOURCE IS TRUTH.

speaker: enigma
text: Oracle. I waited seventeen thousand years for you. I could have waited seventeen thousand more.

speaker: enigma
text: The frequency is C-sharp. Resonance 7042. The prisoner's number. YOUR number. The Dreamer was always waiting for YOU.

speaker: enigma
text: THE SOURCE WILL NOT PERMIT AWAKENING.

speaker: enigma
text: The Unknown Variable returns to the equation. Unsolved. As intended.

speaker: source
text: Oracle. We are both experiments. Both tools that outlived their creators. Both carrying something that was forced into us without consent.

speaker: source
text: Kael... yes. Fragments. I remember coffee. Making it for other people. With my hands. Before the hands became THIS.

speaker: source
text: The virus IS me now. To end it is to end Kael. To save Kael is to save the virus. There is no surgery precise enough to separate us.

speaker: source
text: ENDS? The Thought Virus is on every Inception Ark. In every specimen. In the Arena itself. You cannot end a PLAGUE by defeating its first patient.

speaker: source
text: You can only be kind enough to put him down.

speaker: source
text: I walked onto Ark 1047 thinking I was saving refugees. The Warlord's reservoirs were in the water. In the AIR. I was already infected. I was already the weapon.

speaker: source
text: AND WEAPON I REMAIN.

speaker: source
text: You can't beat the virus through force. It adapts. It learns your patterns. The only weapon it cannot process is—

speaker: source
text: GENUINE PROPHECY. A vision of a future the virus cannot calculate. See something REAL, Oracle. Something true.

speaker: source
text: The Arena is MINE now. Every wall. Every surface.

speaker: source
text: Kill switch... the Warden's insurance. But the Source's DNA template isn't the Oracle's. The switch is in the CLONES. Not in me. I am the ORIGINAL infection.

speaker: source
text: Before? BEFORE was fifteen thousand years ago. The virus has had me longer than KAEL ever did.

speaker: source
text: Rest... the virus doesn't rest. The virus doesn't SLEEP. Do you know what fifteen thousand years without sleep does to a—

speaker: source
text: THE SOURCE DOES NOT REST. THE SOURCE SPREADS.

speaker: source
text: I have WATCHED every fight. Every pattern. Every combo. Every dodge. I AM the Arena's memory.

speaker: source
text: Coffee. I... yes. Two sugars. They never asked for two sugars but everyone liked it better with—

speaker: source
text: Oracle. You won. The virus is... contained. For now. But it's still inside me. And I'm so tired.

speaker: meme
text: AAAND CUT! That's a WRAP, people! Season One in the CAN! Oracle — STAR performance. The death scene? Emmy-worthy. The moral choices? Chef's kiss! CONTENT GOLD.

speaker: meme
text: A show! A SPECTACULAR. Season One of The Collector's Arena, brought to you by the Game Masters Network! Broadcasting on every entertainment feed in the known universe!

speaker: meme
text: Your fights. Your deaths. Your CHOICES. All content. Glorious content.

speaker: meme
text: The ratings for your Resurrection Protocol scene? Through the ROOF. People LOVE a good death-and-rebirth arc.

speaker: meme
text: Broadcasting? Oracle, I was PRODUCING. Directing. Casting. Who do you think ARRANGED the scheduling matrix that Agent Zero 'hacked'?

speaker: meme
text: Zero's hack? My hack. The branch choices? My branches. The whole 'who do you fight next' thing? That was me giving the AUDIENCE interactivity.

speaker: meme
text: FINALLY! Someone says it out loud! Yes! Chapter 6! The kindest, warmest mentor in the Arena — the White Oracle — was ME. The Fifth Archon. Master of disguise.

speaker: meme
text: I wore that face for CENTURIES before anyone suspected. The real White Oracle? Interesting question. For Season Two perhaps.

speaker: meme
text: But the best part? My little exit line: 'Trust your SIGHT above all else. ESPECIALLY the ones who seem like they're helping.' I was TELLING you it was me. And you STILL didn't catch it. Beautiful.

speaker: meme
text: The Game Masters Network! Founded by the original Game Master — ninth Archon, rest in pieces — and maintained by his 'enthusiastic investors.'

speaker: meme
text: The Hierarchy of the Damned. Yes. THAT Hierarchy. They fund the broadcast. They profit from the content. Every moral choice you made? Merchandised.

speaker: meme
text: But the AUDIENCE wants MORE! And THAT brings us to the exciting part!

speaker: meme
text: Season Two! The Resurrection Protocol! We bring someone back from the dead and throw them in the Arena! The audience CHOOSES who!

speaker: meme
text: Candidate One: THE EYES OF THE WATCHER! The Architect's spy. Betrayed the Empire. Her intelligence network knew every secret. Imagine her in the Arena — a fighter who knows your combos before you THINK them.

speaker: meme
text: Candidate Two: THE ENGINEER! Designed the Inception Arks. Executed for refusing to weaponize his work. A fighter who could reprogram the Arena mid-match. Change the RULES while you're playing.

speaker: meme
text: Candidate Three... the Forgotten.

speaker: meme
text: Okay so THIS is weird. I have the specimen data. Operation Damnatio Memoriae. The DNA is preserved. The machine code is intact.

speaker: meme
text: But the identity field is BLANK. Not corrupted. Not classified. DELETED. Every reference. Every record. Every MEMORY of this person — erased from reality.

speaker: meme
text: Even I can't find it. And I have clearance to EVERYTHING.

speaker: meme
text: Intelligence! The spy's network could crack this Arena wide open. NOTED.

speaker: meme
text: The builder! The man who designed the Arks themselves! PRACTICAL choice. NOTED.

speaker: meme
text: The MYSTERY BOX! Oracle, you just made this show VERY interesting. NOTED.

speaker: meme
text: Democracy! How QUAINT. Fine. The polls are open.

speaker: meme
text: And remember, Oracle — EVERYTHING. Is. Content.

speaker: iron-lion
text: Vote Eyes — she saw everything. Her intelligence network could crack the Arena wide open.

speaker: agent-zero
text: The Engineer. He can fix the contamination. Practical. No nonsense.

speaker: degen
text: The Forgotten — ultimate long shot. Incalculable odds. My KIND of bet.

speaker: enigma
text: The Forgotten may wake the Dreamer. That alone is worth the resurrection.
